children: Mitesco's revenue fell to zero from $3,000 year over year, as the company shifted limited resources to software projects, reducing data center revenue. Its loss available to common shareholders narrowed, reflecting lower derivative-liability revaluation losses and a gain on settlement of Series A preferred shares, partly offset by higher operating expenses and interest expense.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) available to common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Dilutive Net income (loss) per common share”.
: Revenue declined as limited resources shifted to new software projects.
: The prototype is being tested by a small group of agents; management expects its first licensing in Q1 FY2027 and a full production version in Q2 FY2027.
: A small engineering group is developing initial units and standards; management believes it can place up to 10,000 units over 3 to 5 years.
: The sports-property marketplace is operational, with property search functionality similar to leading online real estate marketplaces.
